leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a functional component and wrap it with React.memo to prevent unnecessary re-renders.
Apply React.memo to a component that receives primitive props and observe the performance benefit.
Construct a parent component that updates state and passes props to a memoized child component.
Configure a custom comparison function for React.memo to control re-renders based on specific prop changes.
Manipulate non-primitive props (like objects or arrays) and adjust memoization to handle them correctly.
Initialize a side-by-side comparison between a memoized and a non-memoized component to visualize rendering differences.
Integrate React.memo into a component tree to optimize rendering in a multi-level hierarchy.
